I don't need a readme. Create a visually appealing presentation with professional design, clear hierarchy, and excellent use of space. Use modern, clean design principles.",

  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "Create a 5-slide professional presentation on Prompt Engineering:

Slide 1: Title Slide
- Title: Mastering Prompt Engineering
- Subtitle: A Practical Guide to Getting Better AI Outputs
- Include: Your Company Name

Slide 2: What is Prompt Engineering?
- Definition: The art and science of crafting effective instructions for AI systems
- Why it matters: Better prompts = Better results
- Key principle: Clear communication drives AI performance

Slide 3: The Anatomy of a Great Prompt
- Context: Provide relevant background information
- Objective: State what you want clearly
- Requirements: Specify format, length, style
- Examples: Show what good looks like

Slide 4: Common Prompt Mistakes
- Being too vague or generic
- Not specifying output format
- Asking multiple questions at once
- Forgetting to provide context
- Using ambiguous language

Slide 5: The CORE Framework
- C: Context - Set the scene
- O: Objective - State your goal
- R: Requirements - Define constraints
- E: Examples - Show, don't just tell

Slide 6: Advanced Techniques
- Chain of Thought: Ask AI to explain reasoning
- Few-Shot Learning: Provide multiple examples
- Role Assignment: Give AI a specific persona
- Iterative Refinement: Build on previous outputs

Slide 7: Prompt Engineering for Business
- Customer Service: Consistent, branded responses
- Content Creation: On-brand marketing materials
- Data Analysis: Structured insights from complex data
- Code Generation: Efficient development workflows

Slide 8: Best Practices
- Start simple, then add complexity
- Test and iterate your prompts
- Document what works
- Share learnings with your team
- Build a prompt library

Slide 9: Real-World Example
- Bad Prompt: Write about AI
- Good Prompt: Write a 500-word blog post explaining how small businesses can use AI chatbots to improve customer service, including 3 specific use cases and ROI estimates. Target audience: non-technical business owners.
- Result: Specific, actionable, targeted content

Slide 10: Key Takeaways & Next Steps
- Prompt engineering is a learnable skill
- Clear communication is the foundation
- Practice with the CORE framework
- Start building your prompt library today
- Resources: promptingguide.ai, learnprompting.org"
    }
  ],
